chapter: Small's Paradise, Fletcher Henderson and Horace
title: Covering for Hawkins in Fletcher's band while with Arthur Gibbs
summary: Hawk would leave when Fletcher came in; Caldwell played sets with Gibbs and Fletcher at the Savoy and Roseland and got two pays.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Well, that's strange. Yeah, well now, after these two bands at Small's, you go to Fletcher.
Worked with Fletcher for -- and Hawk would always take off. But every time Fletcher would come in, Hawk would take off. He didn't care. So Hawk would call me when he worked at the club.
Oh, I see. So he'd left (unintelligible), enjoy himself.
Well, how long were you with Fletcher?
Oh, off and on, say, like a month.

He'd come in town. Like we'd be at the Savoy, and Fletcher would be coming in to play the Savoy, and up there with Arthur Gibbs. So I have to switch from one band to the other band, play this with Arthur Gibbs' band. Fletcher says, come on. I play the set with Fletcher's band. So I'm getting two pays. (unintelligible).
Well, that suited Hawk very well.

That suited Hawk well. Every time he'd come in, we'd be up at the Roseland Casino. Hap, got a gig for you. Of course, you had to be careful (unintelligible) because you'd go from one band to the other band, and when you'd quit
playing the half hour here, going over to the other bandstand to play the other half.
